description.zh:
修改后的订阅对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见[迁移、同步或订阅对象说明](~~209545~~)。
> - 原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要订阅的对象，否则可能会导致订阅对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
- 原订阅对象，可调用[DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~)进行查询。
description.en:
The modified subscription objects, in JSON format. For more information about the definition, see [Objects of DTS tasks](~~209545~~).
> - The new DbList value overwrites the original DbList value. Make sure that the new DbList value contains all the objects that you want to track. Otherwise, objects may be lost. Modify this parameter with caution.
- You can call [DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~) to query the original subscription objects.
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

description.zh: DTS实例所在地域，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
修改后任务是否订阅DDL类型的数据，取值：

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether the modified task subscribes to DDL data. Valid values:

- **true**: The task subscribes to DDL data.
- **false**: The task does not subscribe to DDL data.

description.zh:
修改后任务是否订阅DML类型的数据，取值：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether the modified task subscribes to DML data. Valid values:
- **true**: The task subscribes to DML data.
- **false**: The task does not subscribe to DML data.

descriptions.zh: > 您可以根据需求在控制台进行相应的预配置，然后预览对应配置的OpenAPI参数信息，以协助您填写请求参数。更多信息，请参见[预览OpenAPI的请求参数](~~2851612~~)。
descriptions.en: > You can perform the required preconfigurations in the console and then preview the corresponding OpenAPI parameter information to help you fill in the request parameters. For more information, see [Preview OpenAPI request parameters](~~2851612~~).
